reason: The pay-on-delivery escrow and the 5% fee instead of Urban Company's ~25% markup is a real reason to try it once, but I'm not betting a big job on a freelancer I've never heard of just because an app shows a badge.
objection: You're telling me the booking numbers near me are still small while you onboard the first batch - so how do I know those few ratings aren't just the founder's friends, and that this 'verified' freelancer is actually any good?
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour or relative I actually trust has booked through hithozha and the freelancer showed up and did a good job, I'd stop asking around and just use the app.
